correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the published free rank-three O-lattice and explicit anti-reflection action. Since alpha^2-alpha+2 splits as alpha(alpha-1) modulo 2, J[2] splits into two 3-dimensional H-stable factors. Exact F_2 computation gives paired group order 168, a unique nonzero perfect intertwining form P, a one-dimensional invariant alternating-form space, no invariant nonzero linear functional, quadratic form q with 36 zeros and 28 ones, orbit sizes 1+7+7+21+28, and every fusion-table entry. The Weil-pairing identification follows because the canonical principal polarization is H-invariant and the invariant nonzero alternating form is unique. The theta interpretation uses the standard correspondence between quadratic refinements and theta characteristics. The bundled verifier reproduces all finite claims.
